policy.firstPublished: Earliest appearance of the reality: the pinned Marvel Database reality page's First field, dated by its cover year. The owner decided this convention and the cover-date convention on 2026-11-14. Named-line years and on-sale dates are retained as alternatives.
policy.realityFirst: Reference reality page First field; it is the selected debut unless the primary-continuity or preview rule below applies.
policy.preview: Promotional and preview comics are alternatives but are excluded from the selected debut. This is standing practice that the owner has not ruled on, so Heroes Reborn (1996) keeps Fantastic Four #1 rather than the Heroes Reborn half-issue preview.
policy.primaryContinuity: Earth-616 begins with Marvel Comics #1 (1939) by explicit owner decision on 2026-11-14, an exception to earliest appearance. The 1936 Ka-Zar pulp, Motion Picture Funnies Weekly #1 (1939) and Fantastic Four #1 (1961) are retained as alternatives.
policy.descriptions: The thirty owner descriptions are reproduced verbatim; source prose is not copied.
policy.secondOpinion: The owner supplied the original years; this ledger checked them against the pinned Marvel Database pages, which are the second opinion the owner asked for. They are not independent of this ledger's own sources. A live reread on 2026-11-14 found all 31 reality pages and all 31 selected-issue pages at their pinned revisions, with unchanged First fields and cover dates.
settled: Year convention: earliest appearance of the reality.
Merge approval for the Universes section.
open: Preview and promotional comics: excluded as standing practice, not ruled on by the owner.
Independent bibliography for every year and debut.
The Heroes Reborn Wizard special: classification and on-sale date unverified.
policy.evidenceGaps: Independent bibliography remains unverified, as do the Wizard special's classification and on-sale date. Seven provider on-sale dates differ from the pinned issue pages. Six are the first day of the cover month and one is January 10, 1969; two of the seven (Marvel Super-Heroes #18 and X-Men #40) fall in a later year than the pinned on-sale date but in the cover year, so no selected year depends on them.
